python3 << 'EOF'
import parse

@parse.with_pattern(r'[a-z]+')
def lower_convert(s):
    return s

extra_types = {'lower': lower_convert}

# Case-sensitive should only match lowercase
result = list(parse.findall('{word:lower}', 'Hello world hello WORLD', extra_types=extra_types))
print('Case sensitive matches:', len(result))
for r in result:
    print(' ', r.named['word'])

# Case-insensitive should match both
result2 = list(parse.findall('{word:lower}', 'Hello world hello WORLD', extra_types=extra_types, case_sensitive=False))
print('Case insensitive matches:', len(result2))
for r in result2:
    print(' ', r.named['word'])
EOF
